definitions.explanation: A marker or trigger in a program or game that indicates a certain condition has been met.
In internet and otaku culture, an event or statement that foreshadows a particular outcome. Often used for cliché story developments, especially death scenes or romantic developments.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧フラグ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回収|かいしゅう}しない→回収する：21142_kaishuusuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}めない→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: You can't progress unless you trigger this event flag.

examples.japanese: ⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧フラグ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すべて⟦{満|み}たした→満たす：09889_mitasu⟧。
examples.english: I met all the condition flags in the game.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦{死亡|しぼう}→死亡：03198_shibou⟧フラグだ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
「⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{戦|たたか}い→戦い：02070_tatakai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わったら→終わる：00567_owaru⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧んだ」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧フラグだ。
examples.english: "When this battle is over, I'm going to get married" is a total death flag.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧フラグ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てて→立てる：01196_tateru⟧おいて、⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{回収|かいしゅう}した→回収する：21142_kaishuusuru⟧。
examples.english: He set up the flag himself and then perfectly followed through on it.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 2 is the more distinctively Japanese usage. フラグ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (a flag is raised) means a foreshadowing event has occurred. フラグ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回収|かいしゅう}する→回収する：21142_kaishuusuru⟧ (to collect a flag) means the foreshadowed event actually happens.

TYPES:
- ⟦{死亡|しぼう}→死亡：03198_shibou⟧フラグ: death flag — when a character says or does something that foreshadows their death
- ⟦{恋愛|れんあい}→恋愛：12634_renai⟧フラグ: romance flag — an event that foreshadows a romantic development
- ⟦{生存|せいぞん}→生存：04335_seizon⟧フラグ: survival flag — signs a character will survive

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- フラグ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: a flag is raised (foreshadowing occurs)
- フラグ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回収|かいしゅう}する→回収する：21142_kaishuusuru⟧: to follow through on foreshadowing
- フラグ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{折|お}る→折る：01263_oru⟧: to break a flag (avoid the foreshadowed outcome)
- フラグ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧: to set up foreshadowing
